title: Xray
description: Traffic, online users and outbound health of Xray-core, from github.com/samssh/xray-exporter.

panels.title: Instances
panels.description: Exporters whose collectors all succeeded (xray_up). An instance is down when Xray is unreachable or any enabled collector fails.

panels.title: Online users
panels.description: Users with at least one open connection. Needs --collector.online and statsUserOnline in Xray's policy.

panels.title: Traffic
panels.description: Traffic through all inbounds in the selected time range.

panels.title: Bandwidth
panels.description: Current traffic rate through all inbounds.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Uptime of the most recently restarted Xray.

panels.title: Collectors
panels.description: Collectors that failed in the last scrape. See the Exporter row and the exporter's logs for which and why.

panels.title: Total bandwidth
panels.description: Traffic rate through all inbounds. Upload is drawn below the axis.

panels.title: Instances
panels.description: Traffic is for the selected time range.

panels.title: Usage by ${dimension}
panels.description: Traffic of each ${dimension} in the selected time range. For users, the tag is the user's email.

panels.title: Online users
panels.description: Needs --collector.online. Xray only counts open connections, and ignores connections from localhost.

panels.title: Online IPs per user
panels.description: Number of IPs each online user is connected from. Needs --collector.online.

panels.title: Users per inbound
panels.description: Users configured on each inbound, not the number online. Needs --collector.handler.

panels.title: Outbound health
panels.description: Result of the latest observatory or burstObservatory probe. Needs --collector.observatory.

panels.title: Probe delay
panels.description: Probe delay of outbounds that are up. With burstObservatory, the average RTT of the sampling window.

panels.title: Outbounds
panels.description: Protocol needs --collector.handler, status and delay need --collector.observatory, failed probes need burstObservatory, and Balancer needs --collector.balancer.

panels.title: Balancer selection
panels.description: Outbounds each balancer prefers over time (leastPing and leastLoad), and manual overrides. Needs --collector.balancer with --collector.balancer.tag.

panels.title: GC pause time
panels.description: Share of time Xray spends in stop-the-world GC pauses.

panels.title: Collector status
panels.description: Whether each enabled collector succeeded. When one fails, the exporter's log says why.
